text: We carry out detailed analyses of the various tax implications of local and international restructuring projects—including spin-offs, mergers, and acquisitions—aimed at optimizing your operations. We prepare and submit requests to the tax authorities regarding these restructurings, handle the preparation and filing of tax reports (dictámenes fiscales) for the sale of shares required in such transactions, and manage the filing of all necessary notifications as well as the monitoring of the respective merger and spinoff procedures.
